open_release.rationale: The paper motivates synthetic data as a way to make sensitive data accessible to researchers and adds anti-copying safeguards.

quotes.text: can help to make sensitive data accessible to researchers
which was used to generate the synthetic population for research on disclosure risk and the mosaic effect.

pipeline_testing.rationale: The sources show no testing or format-conformance purpose.

ml_augmentation.rationale: The paper reports machine learning efficacy of models trained on the synthetic data.

quotes.text: REaLTabFormer also achieves state-of-the-art results on prediction tasks, "out-of-the-box", for large non-relational datasets without needing fine-tuning.

statistical_replication.rationale: The paper evaluates how well synthetic data captures relational and distributional structure of real data.

quotes.text: Experiments using real-world datasets show that REaLTabFormer captures the relational structure better than a baseline model.

education.rationale: No teaching framing appears; the README is a usage guide.

benchmarking.rationale: It is the proposed method compared against baselines, and the sources do not show it used as a baseline or benchmark data.
